searchText: my attempt at a resolution: <https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/386> thanks for the ping will bring up with team if there's more opinion generally prefer this to the more discrete version, since this comparison factor seems like something that would come up at some point anyway. having the special max value essentially is a special case, really, which there's no way is going to be actually computed in any meaningful sense. presumably implementations will just detect some variation of `$very_large_number` and treat it specially (whether by saturating arithmetic, etc). just opened https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/387 to follow up on previously started discussions

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content:
generally prefer this to the more discrete version, since this comparison factor seems like something that would come up at some point anyway.

having the special max value essentially is a special case, really, which there's no way is going to be actually computed in any meaningful sense. presumably implementations will just detect some variation of `$very_large_number` and treat it specially (whether by saturating arithmetic, etc).
